announcements.headline: Northern Zone Clears Path to Final Mining Permit
announcements.insight: Northern Zone has cleared the path to its final mining permit, following the key application submitted in August. This advances the progress towards mining outlined in July.

announcements.headline: Key Permit Application Submitted for Northern Zone
announcements.insight: Following infrastructure surveys in August, Oracle Power has submitted a key permit application for its Northern Zone. This step is critical for progressing towards the mining activities mentioned in July.

announcements.headline: Infrastructure & Transport Surveys Completed
announcements.insight: Surveys completed follow the July mining lease grant. This indicates ongoing preparatory work for the Northern Zone project.

announcements.headline: Update on Mining Permit Applications
announcements.insight: Following the July lease grant and capital raise, this update tracks progress. Shareholders should monitor for further operational milestones.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow recent capital raising and mining lease progress. This confirms governance procedures were completed.

announcements.headline: Progress towards Mining at Northern Zone
announcements.insight: Progress towards mining follows the July lease grant and capital raise. Shareholders should watch for further operational updates.

announcements.headline: Placing to Raise £500,000
announcements.insight: Oracle Power raises £500,000 via placing. This follows the July mining lease grant for its Northern Zone Gold Project.

announcements.headline: Mining Lease Granted - Northern Zone Gold Project
announcements.insight: Oracle Power has secured a mining lease for its Northern Zone Gold Project. This marks the first recorded development step for the company.
